title: Uber vs Lyft
shortAnswer: Uber is the global ride-sharing leader operating in 70+ countries with additional revenue from Uber Eats. Lyft operates only in the US and Canada but often offers lower prices and a friendlier driver experience.
verdict: Uber for global coverage and food delivery. Lyft for a more rider-friendly US experience.

lines.hook: Two apps, same road. One runs 70 countries, the other never left home.
lines.tape: Uber built an empire. Lyft built a cheaper ride in one corner of it.
rounds: 70-plus countries versus two. Uber is infrastructure, Lyft is a regional option.
68 to 32. Uber takes two out of every three American rides.
Uber Eats means Uber earns when nobody's riding. Lyft has no plan B.
Lyft's lower average fare is the whole pitch, and it's a real one.
lines.verdict: Uber takes it 3-1 on scale. Pick Lyft if your ride is domestic and the price matters.

youtubeTitle: Uber vs Lyft: Which Rideshare App Actually Wins?
youtubeDescription:
We compare Uber and Lyft on global coverage, US market share, food delivery, and average fare. Uber dominates on scale with 70+ countries and 68% of the US market, while Lyft counters with lower prices in the US and Canada. Here's which one you should actually be opening.

Figures accurate as of August 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/uber-vs-lyft
